source_text: Zig 0.16.0 was released on September 2026. Major changes include I/O as an Interface, a new ELF linker, and LLVM 21 support.
claim_text: Zig 0.16.0 introduces I/O as an Interface.

source_text: The Great Barrier Reef stretches over 2,300 kilometers off the coast of Queensland, Australia, and is the world's largest coral reef system, visible even from outer space.
claim_text: The Great Barrier Reef is large enough to be seen from space.

source_text: Contrary to popular belief, the Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit — astronauts have repeatedly confirmed this is a myth.
claim_text: The Great Wall of China can be seen from space with the naked eye.

source_text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 Fahrenheit) at standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm, sea level).
claim_text: Water boils at 90 degrees Celsius at sea level.

source_text: The Portland Timbers are a professional soccer club based in Portland, Oregon, playing in Major League Soccer since 2011.
claim_text: Portland's average annual rainfall is about 36 inches.

source_text: Python's asyncio module provides infrastructure for writing single-threaded concurrent code using coroutines, multiplexing I/O access over sockets and other resources.
claim_text: Go's goroutines are more lightweight than OS threads.

source_text: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair in Paris, standing 300 meters tall at the time (excluding antennas), making it the tallest man-made structure in the world for 41 years.
claim_text: The Eiffel Tower, at 330 meters including antennas, was the world's tallest structure for over 40 years.
